title: gahnia lanigera
intro: Gahnia lanigera, commonly known as woolly gahnia, is a perennial rhizomatous herb native to eastern Australia. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Gahnia lanigera include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Gahnia lanigera are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids and phenolic acids, although more research is needed to confirm its full range of bioactive constituents.
